- **`.feed-item-title` / `.feed-item-description`** — semantic typography tokens for size/weight; component-tier color aliases for foreground colors.
- **No raw values** — every property references a token.
- **No `@media` queries** — none needed here; if breakpoints were required, `@custom-media` viewport tokens would be used.

The component-tier tokens (`--shelf-feed-page-*`) need to be defined in `tokens.css` across all three theme blocks (`:root`, `[data-theme="dark"]`, and `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) :root:not([data-theme])`).
